title: Complex equations in Vinod's automatic writing notebook
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Complex equations in Vinod's automatic writing notebook, about 1950s at Round Table Foundation, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There was a lot of like very complex equations that would come through

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi describes a notebook from the 1950s kept at the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine that explored psychic matters. He says that during sessions of automatic writing, where words are said to flow out without the writer's conscious control, a man known as Dr. Vinod produced many very complex equations. If true, it would suggest the messages came from a source with knowledge beyond the person writing them.
